query: E5CK 报警设成"偏差下限+待机序列"之后,一上电过程值就落在报警区间里却没报警,这正常吗?它什么时候才第一次变 ON?
gold_standard: 正常。待机序列(standby sequence)的功能是:过程值一旦离开报警区间、下次再进入区间时,无条件把报警输出关掉(防止上电误报警)。设为"偏差下限+待机序列"时,报警输出第一次 ON 发生在:过程值超出报警设定值离开报警区间之后、再次跌破报警值时。

evidence:
--[p138]-- F Standby sequence
• “Standby sequence” is a function for unconditionally turning alarm output OFF when the process value has left the alarm range once and it next enters the alarm range.
• For example, when the alarm type is set to “deviation lower limit,” generally the process value is within the alarm range, and alarm output become ON as it is as the process value when the power is turned ON is smaller than the set point.
--[p138]-- However, ifthe alarm type is set to “deviation lower limit with standby sequence”, alarm output first becomes ON when the process value exceeds the alarm setting value to leave the alarm range and once again falls below the alarm value.

query: 涡轮分子泵要停机封存一年以上,完整的封存流程怎么做?润滑剂方面有什么特别注意事项?
gold_standard: 停机超过一年:① 从系统上拆下涡轮泵(若抽过腐蚀性/危险性气体,应先用中性气体或干燥空气放气,确保系统和管路无残留工艺气体);② 更换润滑剂储油器(见 7.1),注意:2 年不运行时不应使用润滑剂 TL 011;③ 封闭高真空法兰,并从前级法兰抽真空;④ 经放气口用氮气或干燥空气对泵放气;⑤ 前级口与放气口用盲板封堵;⑥ 泵垂直放置在橡胶脚上;⑦ 存放在潮湿或腐蚀性气氛的房间时,必须把泵连同干燥剂(如硅胶)一起气密封装在塑料袋中。

If the turbopump is to be shut down for more than a year:
➡ Remove turbopump from the system.
--[p359]-- ➡ Change the lubricant reservoir (see Section 7.1.). Please note: Lubricant TL 011 should not be used when there have been no operations for 2 years.
➡ Close the high vacuum flange and evacuate the turbopump via the fore-vacuum flange.
➡ Vent turbopump via the venting connection with nitrogen or dry air.
➡ Close fore-vacuum and venting connection by blank flanging.
➡ Place the pump vertically on its rubber feet.
➡ In rooms with moist or aggressive atmospheres, the turbopump must be air-sealed in a plastic bag together with a bag of dessicant, e.g silicagel.
